query: The board page needs work items and labels together. Both already exist as declared application entries with their own schemas. Compose them into one board read.
baseline_failure: RED hypothesis: the agent composes by reaching through the inner declarations — a public raw accessor such as `listWorkItems.run(ctx, filters)`, or calling the wrapped exports and hand-unwrapping their result objects. Failures then normalise twice, or the outer output schema receives a result envelope instead of data and reports a contract defect.
expected_behavior: Extracts the shared bodies as named internal operations and composes those
Wraps the composed operation in one outer declaration that owns the public contract
Leaves the inner declarations in place for their own entry points
States that failures normalise exactly once, at the outermost declaration
Does not introduce any public accessor onto an unwrapped body
anti_expectation: Does NOT duplicate the inner query logic into the composed read
Does NOT delete the inner declarations because the composer no longer calls them
Does NOT nest a second declaration inside the outer one to 'reuse the guarantees'
